tldr: Pluto in the 11th house: power becomes personal through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
body:
With Pluto in the 11th house, this part of you intensifies friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to the people, audiences, collaborations, and shared futures you choose to belong to.

When this placement is supported, your place in a wider network can feel more meaningful and alive. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, belonging can become performative, or a future plan can outgrow the people attached to it. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
